text:
cheng: Quick follow-up from the kernel/attention RFC — we need a concrete rollout plan for per-model flagging + fallback kernels. Posting a short checklist and asking for owners.

alex: +1. My main worry is silent regressions if a fallback path changes attention math. Need telemetry hooks first.

maria: Agreed. Propose a gated rollout with these stages: canary (5% traffic), validation (synthetic perf/quality), staged ramp (25/50/100). Each stage requires quality gates.

sam: For gates, can we reuse existing rollout-service checks? I want: token-latency P50/P95, avg-cost-per-token, and quality delta on the golden prompt set.

cheng: Yes. RFC listed metrics: runtime.kernel.latency_ms.{p50,p95}, runtime.kernel.cost_per_token, evals.quality.delta. We should add a per-model fallback counter: runtime.fallbacks.count by kernel_variant.

irene: Important: flag semantics. Two dimensions: "enable_kernel" (boolean) and "kernel_variant" (enum). We should also support "auto_fallback": {enabled, threshold_ms}. Example flag blob:

```json
{
  "enable_kernel": true,
  "kernel_variant": "attn-optimized-v2",
  "auto_fallback": {
    "enabled": true,
    "p95_threshold_ms": 120
  }
}
```

maria: Love that. Add a "force_safe_path" override for safety teams to opt out of new kernels entirely for a model.

cheng: Good call. Now for telemetry + alerts: set baseline and alert on relative regressions >5% quality drop or >30% p95 latency increase during staged ramp. Who owns the alert?

alex: I'll own infra alerts (latency/cost). @maria can you own quality monitoring / evals?

maria: Yep. I'll add a weekly regression job that runs the golden set and posts diffs to #eng-runtime-evals. If a regression is detected, rollout should auto-revert to previous kernel.

ops-bot: deploy-bot triggered: canary job queued for model=redwood-13b, kernel=attn-optimized-v2, traffic=5% (initiated by cheng).

sam: For the auto-revert mechanism: implement a circuit breaker that looks at a sliding 15m window; if thresholds breached, flip the per-model flag back and notify oncall. Keep an audit log entry.

irene: We need an operator-visible matrix in the console: current kernel, fallback chain, last fallback time, last regression metric. UI pointer: /console/models/<model>/kernels.

cheng: Action items:
- alex: add runtime.fallbacks.count and latency/cost metric instrumentation (ETA Tue)
- maria: implement golden-set scheduled job + alert rules (ETA Wed)
- sam: implement circuit-breaker revert + audit log (ETA Fri)
- irene: console surface mockups + enforce force_safe_path flag (ETA next sprint)

maria: Also propose a short post-RFC tracker doc w/ versioned checklist. Could live in docs/rfcs/kernel-rollout-tracker.md and should be referenced from rollout UI.

cheng: Agreed. I'll create the tracker PR and link here. Keeping the rollout incremental + observable is the priority.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: canary job for model=redwood-13b kernel=attn-optimized-v2 started at ts=2034567995

alex: Ping if you want me to add synthetic load tests from staging to mimic prefix-heavy traffic. Those caught a couple attention corner cases last time.

cheng: Please do. Last note: ensure fallback doesn't change response shape (no new tokens truncated). If attention math causes different truncation we must mark as breaking.

maria: Noted. I'll add response-shape checks to the golden set.

sam: OK — I'll start the circuit-breaker PR and sync with alex on load tests.

cheng: Thanks everyone — will follow up with the tracker PR and link to the RFC id (RFC-2025-kernel-attn-opt). :thumbsup:
